significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the conclusion that "a subset of mid-depth heads" preferentially represents low-coevolution physical contacts and causally contributes to masked-residue prediction; this combines a form-(i) representation claim with a form-(ii) causal claim bounded to one behavior, rather than a general law. The phenomenon would distinguish attention scores from DCA on cases where proximity and coevolution diverge, while the mechanism would change how the contact-attention correlations reported by Rao et al. (2021) and Vig et al. (2021) are interpreted, but it would not establish that the model generally reasons through biophysical energy or structure. The negative branch—scores being "near-collinear with DCA"—would support the statistical-relay explanation for attention heads, although it would not rule out physical information elsewhere in the model; thus true and false are distinguishable but the conclusion is localized. In the topic-substitution check, the broad topic alone would not earn this score: the specific low-DCA-contact versus distant-high-DCA dissociation is sharper than the median representation-probing hypothesis, but its single-pathway causal scope keeps it near the upper end of the topic baseline.

reach.justification: The named handle is the "physical-vs-coevolutionary precision gap," supplemented by per-head attention scores that could serve as a contact predictor or diagnostic. The gap itself is primarily post hoc because interpreting it requires known contacts and DCA comparisons, although a validated contact-attention score could subsequently be used ex ante for candidate structural inference; the claim does not specify a prospective auditing or deployment gate. After re-extraction, the conclusion predicts mid-depth specialization and superiority on "low-coevolution contacts" only across ESM-2 scales, not a quantitative cross-architecture relation, so downstream uptake is mainly by protein-model and structural-inference researchers rather than broad model deployers. The topic-substitution check does not preserve the score: this particular diagnostic travels farther than a generic claim that scientific structure is represented, but its family-limited scope and calibration-dependent finding keep it within the 5–6 reach band.
